integrity: One exact analytic claim across all documents; finite reproduction checks do not certify infinite convergence; external audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: The fixed-sign cell and monotone vanishing global steps are essential to the stated proof. The theorem concerns unscaled plain sign random reshuffling and does not establish failure of magnitude-corrected, error-feedback, or variance-reduced methods. An equivalent older stochastic-approximation result may exist.
title: Balanced-sign cells trap sign random reshuffling under every decreasing stepsize
